items.source: Creates a new IntoLayerSpec that will control the content of the given layer.
items.translation: 创建一个新的IntoLayerSpec，它将控制给定层的内容。

items.source:
Configures the layer to include project dependencies. If no includes are
specified then all content is included. If includes are specified then content
must match an inclusion and not match any exclusions to be included.
items.translation: 配置该层以包含项目依赖。如果未指定任何包含项，则包含所有内容。如果指定了包含项，则内容必须匹配某个包含项且不匹配任何排除项时才会被包含。

items.source:
Configures the layer to exclude project dependencies. If no excludes a
specified no content is excluded. If exclusions are specified then any content
that matches an exclusion will be excluded irrespective of whether it matches
an include.
items.translation: 配置该层以排除项目依赖。如果未指定任何排除项，则不排除任何内容。如果指定了排除项，则任何匹配排除项的内容都将被排除，无论其是否匹配包含项。

items.source: Spec that controls the dependencies that should be part of a particular layer.
items.translation: 控制应包含在特定层中的依赖项的规范。

items.source: Configures the layer to exclude project dependencies.
items.translation: 配置该层以排除项目依赖项。

items.source: Configures the layer to include project dependencies.
items.translation: 配置该层以包含项目依赖项。

items.source: Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick, Phillip Webb
